message: 彼氏彼女×彼氏彼女

name: Synn
message: 「Now this is some amazing lighting. How did you manage to get all this together~~」

name: Ria
message: 「My big sister was all, 'Don't underestimate the Kujo family!!' Looks like she arranged it separately from the budget」

name: Synn
message: 「With it this bright, Azel probably won't be able to settle down~~」

name: Synn
message: 「Azel isn't good with noisy places, after all~~」

name: Ria
message: 「Muu~~」

name: Synn
message: 「What's wrong?」

name: Ria
message: 「You're talking about Azel-san again」

name: Synn
message: 「Well... we have to settle things between us soon, after all」

name: Ria
message: 「Is that really all?」

name: Synn
message: 「'Is that all'--what else could there be?」

name: Ria
message: 「I'm the one asking you here~~」
Why is she sulking?
Oh, I get it, it really must be...

name: Synn
message: 「Let's stop calling her without honorifics then」

name: Ria
message: 「That's not it!!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Prez~~」
Lolotte dashes over and hugs me.

name: Lolotte
message: 「Did you see those illuminations!? They're amazing!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Whoa!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It's seriously so moving~~\s04」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm looking forward to when it gets dark~」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Because of that, though, the wiring work looks like it's still going to take a while...」

name: Synn
message: 「Then Ria and I will go ahead and handle the changing room」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Huh. Ehh? Right now...」
Lolotte has a puzzled look on her face.

name: Synn
message: 「What's wrong?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「N-No, nothing at all! Well then, I'll be in your care!\s01」
She ran away.

name: Synn
message: 「Maybe we shouldn't do this after all.」

name: Ria
message: 「That's not what's bothering me!!」

name: Shio
message: 「Hm. All clear here as well!」

name: Synn
message: 「Shio-chan. Good work on guard duty.」

name: Shio
message: 「I am most humbled. However, as this is my sworn duty, there is no need for your concern.」

name: Synn
message: 「Even so, you've got more than just monsters to watch out for.」

name: Shio
message: 「Indeed. To yield to ruffians would bring shame to the name of a warrior. Therefore, Lord President, might I ask that you attack me?」

name: Synn
message: 「W-Why?」

name: Shio
message: 「I wish to master an escape technique for emergencies. Now, come at me.」

name: Synn
message: 「I-I see. Well, if you insist. Here I go!」

name: Shio
message: 「Waaah!! P-Pinning me astride right off the bat--how underhanded!?」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, Shio-chan told me to attack her... When you say 'attack,' this is how you do it, right, Ria?」

name: Ria
message: 「Why are you asking me?!\s03」

name: Shio
message: 「W-What did you just say...?」
Shio-chan looks surprised.

name: Synn
message: 「Is something wrong?」

name: Shio
message: 「N-No, nothing. It is nothing at all!\s01 Now then, I must return to my patrol!\s01」
She ran away.

name: Ria
message: 「Hmph!」

name: Synn
message: 「That was just training, training!」

name: Ria
message: 「It looked like you were enjoying yourself!」

name: Synn
message: 「Do you think calling you by your first name makes me feel superior or something?」

name: Ria
message: 「Like I said, that's not it!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Synn!!」

name: Misa
message: 「Sakura-kuun!!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hmph」

name: Misa
message: 「Hmph-hmph」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I called him first!」

name: Misa
message: 「Priority is determined by the importance of the matter」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hand Synn over!──」

name: Misa
message: 「Sakura-kun is coming with me!」

name: Synn
message: 「Waaah, what are you doing all of a sudden──」

name: Synn
message: 「I-I can't breathe…… Help me, Ria」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Huh?」

name: Misa
message: 「Wha!?」
Both of them freeze up.

name: Nanaka
message: 「W-Well, that's normal, right? They have that kind of relationship, after all\s01」

name: Misa
message: 「W-When did they…… Could it be he already declared himself the man of the house……!?」

name: Synn
message: 「So, what did you want?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I just remembered I had something else to do. Later!\s01」

name: Misa
message: 「Ah, me too!\s01」

name: Synn
message: 「Haa…… haa…… That was awful」

name: Ria
message: 「You're quite popular, Synn-kun」

name: Synn
message: 「If you're that mad about it, I'll stop. I'll go back to calling you Ria-senpai like before──」

name: Ria
message: 「I--said--that's--not--it!」

name: Misasagi
message: 「I can't bear to watch this, Mr. President」

name: Synn
message: 「What's this all of a sudden?!」

name: Misasagi
message: 「You really shouldn't be flirting with other girls right in front of your sweetheart」

name: Ria
message: 「A-Awawa--\s03」

name: Synn
message: 「If that's how it is, please just say so……」

name: Ria
message: 「There's no way I could say that, and besides, I had the wrong idea the whole time!」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Heehee…… To think Ria's getting all jealous~」

name: Ria
message: 「I-I'm not jealous at all!!」
Whoa there, this is where I need to step in like a real man.

name: Synn
message: 「Because I only have eyes for Ria」
Misasagi-senpai is giving me a puzzled look…….

name: Synn
message: 「Let's stop dropping the honorific after all. Everyone's giving us weird looks」

name: Ria
message: 「I see……」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Well, if you call me 'senpai' while calling Ria without any honorific, it's gonna get pretty confusing, right?」

name: Ria
message: 「G-Good point」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Or maybe you could drop the honorific for me too? Just call me Ayanishiki\s04」

name: Synn
message: 「Eh, eeeh?!」

name: Synn
message: 「You're cute, Ayanishiki」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Ria's right here, you can't do that! Though, I really like you too, Mr. President!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Me too…… Love'in you」

name: Ria
message: 「Th-That's NOT okay--!!」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Heehee. I'm only teasing」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, at the very least, let me keep calling you Ria-senpai until we leave this academy」

name: Misasagi
message: 「That's right, that's right. If she doesn't do that, Ria's gonna end up looking like the younger one.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「That's why she's always acting more grown-up than she really is. Well, that's the adorable part about Ria, though.」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-You shouldn't say that out loud...」

name: Misasagi
message: 「At least save that for when the two of you are alone.」

name: Ria
message: 「No!! From now on, dropping my honorific is strictly forbidden!!」
Doing the final wrap-up with Ria-senpai. We're going over the schedule for tomorrow's dance party one last time.

name: Synn
message: 「Misasagi-senpai... she really seemed to want to dance with you, Ria-senpai.」

name: Ria
message: 「Hmph, I don't care about Ayane-chan anymore!」

name: Synn
message: 「...Good grief, reacting right away like that is exactly why people call you childish.」

name: Ria
message: 「Hmph! And here I went out of my way to treat you like an adult, Synn-kun.」

name: Synn
message: 「You really don't need to do that!」

name: Ria
message: 「Even so, having you treated like the adult and me like the kid is completely unacceptable!」

name: Synn
message: 「I like both your mature side and your childish side, Ria-senpai... you know?」

name: Ria
message: 「Y-You can't fool me with sweet talk like that!」

name: Ria
message: 「So, what's the mature part about me?」

name: Synn
message: 「For example, how considerate you are of everyone around you--I've always admired how attentive you are to every detail.」

name: Ria
message: 「I see.」

name: Synn
message: 「And also, how comforting you are... When you hug me, I feel so safe and at ease...」

name: Ria
message: 「I-Is that so... That's kind of embarrassing\s03」

name: Synn
message: 「O-Of course... that's not all there is to it, though...」

name: Ria
message: 「Then what's the childish part about me?」

name: Synn
message: 「The part where you insist on asking and double-checking things like this.」

name: Ria
message: 「Fine, I won't do it anymore!」
Being this straightforward and simple is pretty childish too, honestly...
Still, I think having that contradictory mix is what makes Ria-senpai so wonderful.
Ever since I became Student Council President, I've been working hard just to catch up to Ria-senpai.
Still, just when I think I've caught up, she pulls ahead again.
Ria-senpai is working hard too, trying not to let me overtake her.
That's why the two of us keep growing.
Slowly, step by step, we're growing up toward adulthood.

name: Synn
message: 「So don't sulk anymore. Please make sure you dance properly with Misasagi-senpai tomorrow.」

name: Ria
message: 「It's fine. I know, I know~♪」

name: Ria
message: 「After all, it's our very last Holy Night Festival...」

name: Ria
message: 「So, you see, I want to make a really wonderful memory for the finale~~!」

name: Synn
message: 「Right.」

name: Ria
message: 「Synn-kun... who are you going to dance with?」

name: Synn
message: 「I won't dance with anyone. Because the only person I want to dance with is you, Ria-senpai.」

name: Ria
message: 「Synn-kun...!」

name: Synn
message: 「Mmh!?」
She suddenly threw her arms around me and kissed me.

name: Ria
message: 「Heehee, did I surprise you?」

name: Synn
message: 「Of course you did!!」

name: Ria
message: 「Well, you were just so super cute right now, Synn-kun...」

name: Synn
message: 「Catching me off guard like that isn't fair...\s03」

name: Ria
message: 「Then this time, let's do it pro~perly...」

name: Ria
message: 「It's already been three months since I met you and the others, Synn-kun...」

name: Synn
message: 「What's wrong?」

name: Ria
message: 「I was just thinking how fast time really flies when you're having fun.」
Perhaps feeling a pang of bittersweetness, Ria-senpai presses her body tightly against mine.

name: Synn
message: 「I-I've been watching you since even longer than three months ago, Ria-senpai.」

name: Ria
message: 「Is that so? What a coincidence\s05」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh... you knew about me?」

name: Ria
message: 「Yeah. Because I could see you clearly from the classroom window. Thinking, 'There's a kid rushing in right before the bell'」

name: Synn
message: 「You were watching me...?」

name: Ria
message: 「To think I'd end up falling so head-over-heels for that kid back then~~」

name: Synn
message: 「H-Head-over-heels...」

name: Synn
message: 「Still, somehow... being like this with you, Senpai, feels warm and puts my heart at ease...\s03」

name: Ria
message: 「Is that so, is that so」

name: Synn
message: 「Though, it hurts a little」

name: Ria
message: 「You're a boy, so endure at least this much!」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-Yes, ma'am」

name: Ria
message: 「When it's this cold, it looks like it might snow~~」

name: Synn
message: 「That would be a problem, though. Especially after we worked so hard setting everything up」

name: Ria
message: 「Hehe... No matter what happens, you immediately connect it back to Student Council activities, don't you」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, I am the Student Council President, after all」

name: Ria
message: 「When you became Student Council President. You said it to everyone, remember」

name: Synn
message: 「To everyone... um, do you mean about a 'sparkling school life'?」

name: Ria
message: 「Yeah...\s04 Right now, I really feel like that wish of mine has come true」

name: Synn
message: 「Is that right! I'm glad to hear that~~」

name: Ria
message: 「What about you, Synn-kun? You don't feel it?」

name: Synn
message: 「Hmm. It's not that I don't feel it at all, I think...」

name: Synn
message: 「I wonder why... it just doesn't quite click for me. This whole 'sparkling school life' thing」

name: Ria
message: 「Yeah. When I first heard it, I wondered what on earth it meant, too」

name: Synn
message: 「It's true that being able to be with someone I love, like you, Ria-senpai, means I'm spending a happy school life」

name: Synn
message: 「But that's not quite the same thing as living a 'sparkling school life'」

name: Ria
message: 「Is it about Re-Crea? Because you're worried about what Azel-san is up to...?」

name: Synn
message: 「Maybe... Still, how are you so calm about all this, Ria-senpai?」

name: Ria
message: 「Because I'm totally fine! After all, I know Synn-kun will handle everything for me♪」

name: Synn
message: 「What's that supposed to mean...」

name: Ria
message: 「So I'm not worried at all! Whether it's the Holy Night Festival, Re-Crea, or even Azel-san, I'm just like, 'Bring it on!'♪」

name: Ria
message: 「Ah... just don't go cheating on me with Azel-san, okay? Or else you're getting a big 'no-no'~~」

name: Synn
message: 「How did you jump to that?! Even I wouldn't ever do that with Azel...」

name: Synn
message: 「With... Azel...?」

name: Ria
message: 「Synn-kun?」

name: Synn
message: 「That's it!」

name: Ria
message: 「Huh?」

name: Synn
message: 「I've figured it out! What my true conviction is!!」

name: Ria
message: 「C-Cheating...?」

name: Synn
message: 「Not that!!」
